svg.title: Two minutes of speed: the shape of the wobble, not the pace
svg.desc: Two minutes of speed sampled every second, with each series drawn as a percentage of its own mean so the comparison is about texture rather than pace. The Runsketch trace and the Garmin fenix 2 recording both wander smoothly, drifting several per cent above and below their own averages over tens of seconds, and the two seconds the watch skipped are left as gaps. The Runsketch trace swings wider, from about 10 per cent below its mean to 12 per cent above, against roughly 3 per cent either way for the recording. The fakemy.run formula is a narrow flat band jittering about 1.5 per cent either side with no memory from one second to the next, because its noise is drawn independently at every point.
